scope: Only new consistent reduced-tangent Newton worker, its five tiny fixtures, exact launcher/protocol differences. No SSH, launch, full-network training, or producer evaluation by reviewer.

checks.physics: Engineering-shear Amor tangent independently matched source: g-degraded deviatoric stiffness; tensile volumetric g and compressive volumetric 1. Toy mixed-sign AD+FD and one-sided zero-trace fixture passed.
checks.zero_branch: Selected generalized q=g at exact trace zero is explicitly separated from ReLU AD q=0 and centered-FD q=(g+1)/2. Native directional contracts remain runtime gates, not already-completed producer evidence.
checks.frozen_representation: Loads exact previous transform 401x388/387 and theta0 head. No SVD, ridge, new rank cut, hidden/BC/damage changes, history commits, or rollout. Probe and endpoint assert network, B0 anchor, FEM damage, own lower/f unchanged.
checks.linear_solve: Cholesky solve with finite direction and relative linear residual <=1e-6. Singular/nonpositive/non-descent stops explicitly; no pseudoinverse/ridge repair.
checks.budget: 400 energy/gradient calls inclusive AD/FD/source/native/line/final, reserve last actual readout; no new evaluation or matrix/solve after 600s including preparation. At most10 Newton steps/10 dense assemblies/1000 explicit products; dense assembly full-column work recorded separately.
checks.rollback: Only completed Armijo-accepted trials update last state. Actual scripted interruption-after-first-accept fixture passed. Pending failed evaluation and work counts persist; no failed trial promoted.
checks.actual_readout: Installs raw head then scores actual network E/Ru/L2/H1 and projected head gradient. Conditioned vs actual gradients/energies and realization error remain distinct. Missing terminal readout is partial and not primary evidence.
checks.launcher: Clean git archive plus bundle/contract/worker-blob binding; prior input/model/basis SHA staging; fresh roots; duplicate checks; full post-staging GPU preflight; successful zero-update real tangent-memory probe before production. GPU0 and isolated env/receipt consistent.

claim_boundary: Code Ready only. Actual stationarity requires installed-network reduced infinity gradient <=1e-10; conditioned-only closure is realization-limited. Failure/cap endpoints do not establish retained-feature or whole-network capacity. Fixed-state solve is not new joint PIDL/FEM trajectory or physical teacher.
remaining_before_launch: Parent commits reviewed exact worker/tests/protocol and verifies clean source.
Fresh GPU/process availability and real c1 full-cache tangent/solve/FD zero-update memory probe must pass before two-state production.
